title: Two log formats
hints: time.Parse(time.RFC3339, s) handles "2024-03-05T10:00:00+02:00". Try it first; if it fails, try the second layout.
Write the access-log layout using the reference time: "02/Jan/2006:15:04:05 -0700". -0700 is a numeric zone offset.
Parsed times keep the offset from the input. Return t.UTC() so callers always get UTC, and return an error when neither layout matches.
